source: ClassPad.net Math — exact fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-19 through visible keys and LCD SVG; saved directly to project.
notes: 76 accepted steady-state native observations;3 initial navigation/blank-boot probes retained separately. Each accepted expectation compares the full LCD body and indicators without masks.

ON restarts the active app, including type/root menus. OFF/ON restarts that app rather than HOME; ON while HOME keeps HOME and disables Verify. Menus and drafts/errors are discarded. Named array memories, committed Statistics rows and Geometry side values survive.

ON clears registered f/g definitions: calling f(2) after Calculate ON gives Undefined, and Table ON shows both functions undefined. The FUNCTION menu alone does not prove a retained definition. Numeric variable A=8,Ans,PreAns=8 and complex Ans=2+3i survive the observed restarts.

Base-N FORMAT before entering255 already selects Hex;255 is hexadecimal and the result is00000255. ON keeps Hex. A separate Dec255→FORMAT gives000000FF and remains Hex after ON. Initial decimal label corrected.
The initial Verify-true label was actually No Operator and has been renamed. A second independent1=1 produces True, then ON clears Verify. Complex Verify was independently True before ON.
ON clears Sheet data even from another app. LineI display history clears with ON. Two-line Complex answers place the real part on the row after the expression and the imaginary part on the next row.
